answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior - like a falcon kept by a costly bond, cheap to name but expensive to lose. New identities should also start at basalt level: valid, but low-trust, earning higher limits only through sustained verifiable work. And rewards should be capped per verified credential, not per account, so a sable swarm of sock puppets still shares one ceiling, forcing attackers to pay real stake, time, and compute for each unit of influence.
